title: A Tripeptide-Stabilized Nanoemulsion of Oleic Acid
protocol: Suspend 50 mg of cisplatin in 4 mL of water at 60 °C.
Add dropwise 55.2 mg of AgNO3 in 0.5 mL of water to the solution of cisplatin and stir for at least 2 h at 60 °C.
Centrifuge the reaction mixture at 3,220 x g for 10 min and remove the white precipitate of AgCl.
Collect and filter the supernatant via a 0.2 μm syringe filter.
Test the filtered solution for platinum by applying drops to SnCl2 crystals; color should be dark yellow/orange.
Suspend 94.2 mg of oleic acid in 3 mL of water at 60 °C.
Add 13.3 mg of NaOH in 1 mL of water and mix with the solution of activated Pt(II) from step 1.1.
Stir the reaction for 2 h at 60 °C, then overnight at room temperature.
The crude product is an oily brown/yellow precipitate.
Centrifuge the reaction mixture at 3,220 x g for 10 min.
Remove the supernatant from the centrifuged mixture.
Dry the crude product at 25 °C using a rotary evaporator.
Purify the product by multiple washes with acetonitrile.
Synthesize the KYF using standard solid-state peptide chemistry.
Soak 5.7 g of Fmoc-L-Phe 4-alkoxybenzyl alcohol resin in 25 mL of DMF for 1 h.
Deprotect the amine group of L-phenylalanine amino acid with 15 mL of 20% piperidine/DMF solution for 5 min.
Discard the solvent and repeat the wash with a 20 min cycle.
Wash the resin for 1 min with DMF, isopropyl alcohol (IPA), DMF, IPA, DMF, IPA, DMF in sequence.
Perform the Kaiser test to determine the presence of free NH2 group on the resin.
If positive (the resin seed is purple), add the Fmoc-L-tyrosine amino acid and perform the coupling overnight.
Dissolve 5 g of ninhydrin in 100 mL of ethanol.
Dissolve 80 g of phenol in 20 mL of ethanol.
Mix 2 mL of 0.001 M aqueous potassium cyanide with 98 mL of pyridine.
Add 2-3 drops of each Kaiser test solution to sample and heat in boiling water for 5 min.
Wash the resin for 1 min with DMF, IPA, DMF, methanol, dichloromethane, and diethyl ether; discard solvent after each wash.
Save half of the washed resin for further processing.
Obtain KYF-FITC from the synthesis of KYF-N3 with propargyl fluorescein via a click reaction.
Mix 253 mg of KYF-N3 Wang resin, 3.78 mg of CuI solid, 71.9 mg of propargyl fluorescein, and 2.24 mg of DIPEA.
Wash the resin alternately with DMF and IPA five times.
Wash the resin thrice each with methanol, water, DMF, and dichloromethane, followed by diethyl ether.
Discard the solvent after each wash.
Cleave KYF-FITC or KYF peptide from the resin using a solution of TFA/TIPS/H2O at the ratio of 95/2.5/2.5 for 3 hours.
Precipitate the crude peptide in cold diethyl ether and wash thrice with cold ether.
Dry the precipitated peptide under vacuum.
Dissolve 10 mg of oleic acids–Pt(II) conjugate in 1.5 mL of isopropanol.
Place the syringe containing the solution in a syringe pump set to a flow rate of 0.1 mL/min.
Dissolve 1 mg of FITC-KYF and 1 mg of KYF in 20 mL of water.
Adjust the temperature of the solution to 37 °C.
Cover the walls of the container with aluminum foil.
Add the oleic acids–Pt(II) conjugate dropwise to the solution under the hood.
Stir the solution overnight at room temperature.
Concentrate the FITC-KYF-Pt-NE in a centrifugal concentrator (10k MWCO).
Wash the concentrated solution thrice with 4 mL of nanopure water.
Store the aqueous solutions of KYF-Pt-NE and FITC-KYF-Pt-NE at 4 °C.
Prepare platinum standards in 10% HCl solution for calibration curve.
Analyze platinum content using atomic absorption spectroscopy (AAS).
Dissolve 50 µL of KYF-Pt-NE solution in 100 µL of aqua regia.
Leave the mixture at room temperature overnight.
Add 850 µL of water to reach a final sample volume of 1 mL.
Analyze the sample using AAS.
Record the reading of Pt concentration in ppb.
Compute the final platinum content in the sample, accounting for dilution and initial volume.
Seed 6 ovarian cancer cell lines into 4 well-chamber confocal dishes at a density of 4.7 x 10^4 cells per chamber.
Pre-culture overnight at 37 °C.
Wash the cells thrice with phosphate buffer saline (PBS).
Incubate with FITC-KYF-Pt-NE in cell culture medium for 15 min at 37 °C.
Remove the media after incubation and wash the cells three times with PBS.
Fix the cells with cold methanol for 5 min at -20 °C.
Wash the cells three times with 1 mL of PBS.
Permeabilize the cells with 1 mL of 0.1% Triton-X for 10 min at room temperature.
Wash the cells three times with 1 mL of PBS.
Incubate the cells for 90 min with LAMP1 antibody conjugated with Alexa Fluor 647 (1 mL) at a 1:50 dilution in PBS at room temperature.
Wash the cells three times with PBS.
Dilute DAPI stock solution to 1 μg/mL in PBS.
Add 1 mL of diluted DAPI solution to each chamber and incubate for 15 min at room temperature.
Wash the cells 3 times with PBS.
Mount coverslips on a slide using mounting medium.
Image the cells using live cell confocal microscope at excitation wavelengths of 405 nm, 488 nm, and 633 nm.
Set laser power from 0.2% to no more than 1%, Pinole 1 Airy unit, Gain master 650-750, Digital offset 0.
Open image in imaging software.
Under displayed image, select Graphics.
Select Insert Scale Bar to insert the scale bar into the image.
Adjust pH values of three PBS buffers to 7.4, 6.8, and 5.0 respectively.
Dilute 5 μL of KYF-Pt-NE in 180 μL of appropriate pH PBS buffer.
Transfer diluted solution to 3.5 kDa MWCO mini dialysis cup.
Incubate at 37 °C in PBS.
Remove buffer from each three mini dialysis tubes at 2, 4, 6, 24, 48, and 140 h.
Measure platinum concentrations by AAS.
Culture cell lines A2780, CP70, SKOV-3, OV-90, TOV-21G, ES-2 in DMEM supplemented with 10% FBS (A2780, CP70, SKOV-3, ES-2) or 15% FBS (TOV-21G, OV-90), with L-Glutamine and penicillin/streptomycin.
Grow all cells in a 5% CO2, water-saturated atmosphere at 37 °C.
Seed 3 x 10^5 cells in each well of a 96-well plate.
Pre-culture the seeded cells overnight for incubation experiments.
Prepare KYF-Pt-NE, cisplatin, and carboplatin solutions in water.
Adjust the concentration of Pt(II) in KYF-Pt-Ne to match those of carboplatin and cisplatin for each cell line.
Incubate the plates for 72 hours at 37 °C.
Remove medium from each well after incubation.
Add 110 μL of 10% MTT in medium to each well.
Incubate with MTT for 2 h at 37 °C.
Add 100 μL of detergent to each well.
Incubate with detergent for 5 h at 37 °C.
Check the absorbance at 570 nm using a plate reader.
Analyze results using statistical analysis methods.
